interpretation: Steps 40, 50 and 55 had zero sampled swap usage and zero positive swapin/swapout counter deltas.
Step 57 completed with valid rounds and no context rereads, but later parts had memory pressure and active paging. These results should not be presented as uncontended maximum hardware throughput.
The first nonzero swap observation interval overlaps the end of the one-session round, slot restoration and the beginning of the two-session round. It cannot be attributed solely to two sessions.
Telemetry is whole-system and sampled every 60 seconds. It cannot identify which processes or pages were swapped, quantify slowdown or justify correcting token rates.
vm_stat swap counters are page counters, not measured physical SSD byte traffic; compression affects interpretation.
Desktop apps remained open. GPU utilization and temperature/thermal throttling were not measured.
Original benchmark measurements and logs are preserved. This supplementary review was added before final collection.
